messages:
jana: heads up - customer followed the go quickstart and reported a weird flip: first request during signup returned 200, after they added a card the same app started getting 402s on /v1/generate. UI said "trial credits applied" initially. anyone seen this billing flip?

omar: can you paste the small repro and headers? 200 -> 402 often means billing webhook timing or token swapped.

jana: minimal reproduce from container:
```
export RW_QUICKSTART_KEY=sk-temp-999
./quickstart-go
```
quickstart loads env RW_API_KEY in code. first call: 200 OK. later calls: 402 Payment Required
headers: x-request-id=req_go_11, x-billing-state=verification_pending, x-cache-hit=true
body: {"error":"payment_required","message":"add payment method"}

pei: two root causes we've hit before: (1) quickstart/sample env var inconsistency (README shows RW_QUICKSTART_KEY but code uses RW_API_KEY -> users may be switching keys mid-flow); (2) onboarding creates a transient trial-credit record that shows in UI while processor callback is still pending. combined with our prefix cache the first request can succeed from cache, then enforcement applies later.

omar: also the go-sdk v0.9.1 had a transport change that would retry some 4xx when the cache header is present. 402 should be surfaced immediately. i'll roll a patch to stop retrying 402 for non-idempotent endpoints (owner: omar, eta: 48h).

jana: workaround we gave the customer: regen the service account key after payment verification and restart the quickstart container -> calls returned 200 again. i'll add that to the quickstart troubleshooting note.

onboard-bot: created INF-6001: "go quickstart: env var mismatch + billing webhook race causes 402 flip" assigned to omar. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-6001

support: update playbook: ask for x-request-id, x-billing-state header, org id, and which env var they set. recommend regen+restart as immediate workaround.

pei: action items: (a) unify env var names across all quickstarts to RW_API_KEY (owner: pei, eta: today); (b) add a tiny preflight /v1/billing_status check in quickstarts to warn if billing_state != active (owner: devex, eta: next week); (c) patch go-sdk retry policy (owner: omar, eta: 48h).

jana: customer confirmed workaround worked, i'll close the support ticket once docs PR merges. thanks all.
